name: net.appledger/appledger
title: AppLedger
description: Plain-English security checks for AI-built apps (Trivy + Opengrep), with fix requests for agents

environmentVariables.name: APPLEDGER_MODE
environmentVariables.description: hosted (default): files Git would commit are sent to appledger.net, scanned and deleted. local: Trivy and Opengrep run on this machine.

environmentVariables.name: APPLEDGER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional dashboard connection key (al_...). Without it, nothing goes to a dashboard; a hosted check returns a link that saves its result to a free account (the summary is kept up to 24 hours).
